experiment: HLS-S4 informative Bayesian estimation × Bellman planning
prior_support: 101-point competence grid [0,1], discrete Gaussian weights centered on prior means

definitions.frozen: no observation assimilation; propagate estimate through known MIS-v2 after executed actions
definitions.updated: Bayesian update from executed productive observations, then known MIS-v2 prediction
definitions.bellman: receding-horizon exact S4 recursion from posterior mean; certainty-equivalent only
definitions.reactive: exact immediate maximization from the same current posterior mean
definitions.reward: collective reward from true pre-transition competence
definitions.confidence_interval: paired replicate-level normal approximation 1.96×SE; seed is unit
